answer: Expected command sequence: git log --show-signature -1; git config --show-origin --get gpg.format. Include a result report showing signing, git log --show-signature, trusted identity and identify whether any operation changed only local state or affected a remote.
explanation: A strong submission for Configure and verify commit signing begins with a state check, runs commands in the intended repository, verifies the resulting state, and records safety/compatibility caveats.
